detail.title: SA65BWHG | 6.5KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Black & White)
detail.overview: The SA65BWHG 6.5KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine is built for efficiency and durability. Its rust-free body, spiral pulsator design, and collar scrubber ensure a powerful and thorough clean. Equipped with a toughened glass lid, water level indicator, and noise-free spinning, it delivers hassle-free washing. The powerful motor and lint filter enhance performance, while the end-cycle buzzer adds convenience. Designed to make laundry effortless, this washing machine is the perfect companion for your home.
features: Anti-corrosive rust-free body for long-lasting durability
2 wash programs for efficient and customized cleaning
Spiral pulsator design for deep and powerful wash action
Water level indicator for precise water usage control
Toughened glass lid for enhanced durability and style
Lint filter to trap dirt and ensure cleaner clothes
Collar scrubber technology for tough stain removal
Powerful motor with TOP technology for superior performance
Noise-free spinning for faster and hassle-free drying
End-cycle buzzer for added convenience and time-saving
